summary: Iteration 2 verification of TTS error-handling improvements. ALL 10 backend pytest cases PASS (100%). Two new behaviours confirmed via live curl + pytest: (1) GET /api/tts/health returns {ok:false, scope_missing:true, hint:'Open https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys, edit the key, enable Text to Speech permission, then save.', error:'...'}. (2) POST /api/tts/generate now returns HTTP 503 (not 500) with detail 'Voice service unavailable: ElevenLabs API key lacks text_to_speech permission. Enable it at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.'. No regression in any other endpoint — /api/assessment/tasks, /submit, /history, /{id}, /pose/runner all healthy. Frontend mobile flow Home → Task-intro → Assessment → History verified at 375x667 viewport with zero page errors.

minor.issue: Still returns 503 because user's ElevenLabs key (sk_5de52...) lacks 'text_to_speech' scope. This is the intended new behaviour and an EXTERNAL credential issue confirmed via /v1/user direct curl — no code fix possible. User must enable scope at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.

integration_issues.issue: react-native-webview has no web implementation; preview shows literal 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' under the loading spinner. NOT a bug — native iOS/Android via Expo Go renders /api/pose/runner correctly. Documented in iter 1.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Same as iter 1, non-blocking, likely from a 3rd-party dep.

verified_flows: GET /api/tts/health → 200 with {ok:false, scope_missing:true, hint:'...enable Text to Speech...', error:'...'} ✓
POST /api/tts/generate → 503 with detail containing 'Voice service unavailable' and link to ElevenLabs API keys page ✓
POST /api/assessment/submit → 200, derives functional_issues + rehab_plan, persists to Mongo ✓
GET /api/assessment/history → 200, list sorted desc, no _id leak ✓
GET /api/pose/runner → 200 HTML with MediaPipe + getUserMedia + assessment-start testID ✓
Frontend Home renders hero + Today's plan + How it works + Start Assessment CTA ✓
Open Camera & Begin → /assessment mounts WebView (web placeholder expected) ✓
action_items: [USER-ACTION-REQUIRED, NOT CODE] User must log in to https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys, edit their key, enable 'Text to Speech' (and ideally voices_read, user_read) scopes, save, and the voice feature will work without any code change. /api/tts/health will then return {ok:true}.
[OPTIONAL] Investigate the persistent 'pointerEvents' deprecation warning — likely from a transitive RN library.
critical_code_review_comments: TTS 503 error string includes the exact remediation URL — excellent UX.
/api/tts/health is a great diagnostic surface; consider also exposing it in the frontend Settings screen so users can self-check.
logger is still defined AFTER routes (line 1001); the early TTS error path works because errors only fire at request time, but reorder to module top for cleanliness.
No regression — all MongoDB queries still project {_id:0}; all endpoints typed via Pydantic; all values via env vars.
seed_data_creation: Two additional /api/assessment/submit calls during pytest fixtures (visible in /history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 2 verified the new TTS error-handling. /api/tts/health returns ok:false + scope_missing:true + actionable hint; /api/tts/generate returns 503 + Voice service unavailable message. ElevenLabs scope missing is an EXTERNAL credential problem the user must fix in their dashboard — no code change possible. All other endpoints and all frontend screens regression-free.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of 'voice still unavailable' = ElevenLabs API key sk_5de52... has zero scopes enabled, confirmed via direct call to /v1/user returning missing_permissions for text_to_speech, voices_read, user_read. Reproduction: any POST to /api/tts/generate triggers ElevenLabs 401 missing_permissions which the new handler catches (line 518) and converts to FastAPI HTTPException(503, 'Voice service unavailable: ...'). Mitigation already in place: 503 status + actionable detail + /api/tts/health diagnostic. Final fix is user-side: enable Text to Speech scope at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.
